name: qlrisk_price_margin_lending
title: Price a MarginLending
description:
Price one Margin Lending Transaction (qlrisk MarginLending).
Inputs (* required, name=default): maturity*, notional=1000000, collateral_positions, loan_rate_pct=5, reference_rate=SOFR, spread_bp=200, initial_margin_ratio=1.5, maintenance_margin_ratio=1.25, margin_call_frequency=daily, loan_purpose=portfolio_leverage, is_committed=true, facility_limit, currency=USD. In `advanced` also: effective_date, day_count.
Example: {"maturity": "5Y", "notional": 1000000} gives NPV 1,255,898.73 USD (sample market valued 2026-10-09).
